title: Exclude two funded chart-388 BIT bypasses with seven mutable sends
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

Both priced replacements of grade-five packet 927 fail after seven surviving equations may change and all 138 terminal charts may re-decode. In the grade-two chart-1 model, terminal demands reduce 1,048,576 early settings to 32 and then force the original early payloads and exact late 2583 value. In the grade-four chart-160 model, they reduce 16,384 early settings to one. Only then does the five-coordinate separating input force all eligible new local stock to zero while a required output is one.

## Task and overlap

This is a refined follow-up to [#7852](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7852) at `41beda1d6435760dc99e38bd7e65f36798aad212`, on main `e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57`. Source baseline and previous differently funded recovery paths [#7830](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7830) at `87fbf4f7b35b0f18ab12b5767775a9a424cf0b15`, [#7924](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7924) at `c83039ac63874fa9f9a2fd0bb650469886076dc6`, [#7975](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7975) at `46368d288e9dfad1cffce2af5094cbedfe84cb06`. Both proposed rational contacts have valid nesting. The finite and mathematical stock grants in each model are stated in the archive.

## Validation

From a clean Python 3.12 extraction run `sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS` and `python3 -I -B verify.py`. The 22 manifest entries, original primitive operators, exact tuple decisions, grades and directed conditional invoice diagnostics replayed. A separate scalar interpreter checked the five-coordinate probe from primitive instructions.

## Open next questions

Find an additional exterior route exposing the missing direction on the separating input while satisfying its reader requirements. The known grade reductions are hypothetical outside their failed packet tests and do not establish a κ improvement.
